name: Move-Out Cleaning
short_description: Comprehensive cleaning to guarantee your deposit return.
description:
Move-Out Cleaning

Our comprehensive Move-Out Cleaning service ensures every inch of your property is spotless, helping you get your deposit back. We cover deep cleaning of appliances, cabinets (inside and out), baseboards, bathrooms, and all living areas.
use_cases: End of tenancy, moving out, deposit return prep

name: Move-In Cleaning
short_description: Start fresh with a deeply sanitized and sparkling clean new home.
description:
Move-In Cleaning

Before you unpack, let us sanitize and deep clean your new home. We eliminate dust, grime, and allergens left by previous occupants, ensuring a safe and pristine environment for your family.
use_cases: New home preparation, moving in, sanitization

name: Deep Cleaning
short_description: Intensive, top-to-bottom cleaning for homes that need extra care.
description:
Deep Cleaning

Our Deep Cleaning service targets neglected areas. We hand-wash baseboards, clean inside windows, dust high fixtures, and deep scrub bathrooms and kitchens to restore your home's shine.
use_cases: Spring cleaning, post-renovation, heavy soil removal

name: Carpet Cleaning
short_description: Professional steam cleaning to remove deep stains and odors.
description:
Carpet Cleaning

Revitalize your carpets with our professional hot water extraction (steam cleaning) service. We target deep-seated dirt, stubborn stains, and odors, leaving your carpets looking and smelling fresh.
use_cases: Stain removal, pet odors, routine maintenance

name: Regular House Cleaning
short_description: Standard upkeep cleaning to keep your home looking its best.
description:
Regular House Cleaning

Maintain a beautiful home with our standard cleaning service. Includes dusting, vacuuming, mopping, and surface sanitization of bathrooms, kitchens, and living areas.

name: Wall & Drywall Repair
short_description: Expert patching for holes, dents, cracks, and drywall damage.
description:
Wall & Drywall Repair

Restore your walls to perfect condition. We professionally patch holes (from doorknobs or anchors), fix dents, repair cracks, and seamlessly finish damaged drywall surfaces.
use_cases: Hole patching, water damage repair, dent removal

name: Painting & Touch-Ups
short_description: Wall touch-ups, scuffs, and small paint jobs.
description:
Painting & Touch-Ups

Refresh your space with our precision painting services. Perfect for covering scuffs, matching existing colors for touch-ups, or painting accent walls and small rooms.
use_cases: Scuff coverage, color matching, trim painting

name: General Home Repairs
short_description: Fixes for fixtures, doors, cabinets, blinds, and more.
description:
General Home Repairs

Tackle your honey-do list. We handle a variety of small fixes including squeaky doors, loose cabinet hinges, blind installations, minor fixture replacements, and everyday household repairs.
use_cases: Door adjustments, cabinet repairs, blind hanging

name: Furniture Assembly
short_description: Fast and sturdy flat-pack and general furniture assembly.
description:
Furniture Assembly

Save time and frustration. We expertly assemble flat-pack furniture from IKEA, Wayfair, and other retailers. From bed frames and dressers to complex office desks, we build it right.
use_cases: IKEA assembly, bed frames, office desks

name: TV & Wall Mounting
short_description: Secure TV mounting and installation of wall-mounted fixtures.
description:
TV & Wall Mounting

Enjoy your entertainment safely. We provide professional and secure mounting for TVs of all sizes, soundbars, heavy mirrors, and artwork, ensuring they are perfectly leveled and anchored into studs.
use_cases: TV mounting, mirror hanging, art installation

name: Shelving & Storage Installation
short_description: Installation of shelves, storage units, and organizers.
description:
Shelving & Storage Installation

Maximize your space. We install floating shelves, closet organizers, garage storage racks, and pantry shelving systems securely and precisely.
use_cases: Closet organizers, floating shelves, garage storage

name: Move-Out Repair Package
short_description: Get your deposit back. All-in-one move-out repair bundle.
description:
Move-Out Repair Package

Get your deposit back.

This flat-priced package is specifically aimed at tenants moving out and property managers prepping units. It bundles everything you need to leave the property in perfect condition.

What's Included:

  • Wall & Drywall Repair (patching holes from mounts/pictures)
  • Touch-up painting to cover scuffs and patches
  • General small repairs (doors, cabinets, fixtures)
use_cases: End of lease, property management prep, deposit return

name: Move-In Repair Package
short_description: Settle into your new place. All-in-one new home setup bundle.
description:
Move-In Repair Package

Settle into your new place.

Aimed at people moving into a new home, this flat-priced bundle covers all the essential setup tasks so you can start enjoying your space immediately without the hassle.

What's Included:

  • TV & Wall Mounting
  • Furniture Assembly (flat-packs, beds, tables)
  • Shelving & Storage Installation
  • General small home repairs and adjustments
use_cases: New homeowners, moving in, apartment setup
